source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test stores text/plain/txt handler metadata with preferredAction=alwaysAsk and alwaysAskBeforeHandling=true before opening compose. It registers a watcher for the unknown-content-type dialog before double-clicking the attachment, then awaits the dialog. Cleanup removes the test entry rather than restoring a snapshot of a prior handler. This is explicit local test state; the source and historical Good Try report do not prove the intermittent timeout is cured on native platforms.
title: The attachment-opening test sets Always Ask handler state before waiting for its dialog
